contexts.text: Under Place, see these references. AC 1275. AC 1376. AC 1377. AC 1379. AC 1380. AC 1463.
The homes (of good Spirits) are changed into more beautiful ones as the Spirits are perfected. Described. SE 879.
The good and truth which is with the Angels, by a wonderful conversion, is changed into evil and falsity with the infernals, and this by degrees as it flows down...
The changes of his state are nothing but changes of Societies.
The changes of the state are according to the changes of the Spirits and Angels who are in such good and truth.
He hath changed my hire ten times ()... Ten times = very much change. AC 4179.
Purify yourselves and change your garments () = holiness to be put on... To change the garments = to put on, here, holy truths...

To remove the garments and put on changeable garments () represented purification from falsities... On this account also they had changeable garments, and they were called changeable... because by means of them representations were made.
A cry () = a change.
A change of state less remarkable is indicated by and.
To change () = to remove and reject.
Changeable garments () = truths which are new, and truths become new when they are initiated into good, for they then receive life. Illustrated.
That which belongs to a man cannot be changed into something else by thinking about mediation and salvation; but by a new regeneration...
The thing which thou doest is not good () = that a change must be made.
The dominant [principle] of man's life... is his very will itself, and thus is the very being of his life, which cannot be changed after death. SE 2803. HH 480.
In perpetuity without change, signified.
The external sense was changed... on account of that nation. Explained.
Man's life cannot be changed after death... HH 527:2. NJHD 239. LJ 25. LJ 56.
On the changes of state of the Angels in Heaven. General article.
The Spirits with man are changed according to the changes of his affections...
Goods and truths are changes and variations of the state of the forms of the mind.

There are myriads of concupiscences which enter into and compose each evil, and myriads of affections which enter into and compose each good, and these myriads are in such order and connexion in man's interiors, that one cannot be changed unless all are changed at the same time.
I felt the actual change from a man, although I was not changed...

I have heard from the Angels that the life of anyone cannot be changed after death, because it is organized according to his love and thence works; and that if it were changed the organization would be torn to pieces... Also that a change of organization is possible only in the material body, and is utterly impossible in the spiritual body, after the former has been cast away.
Every man changes his situation in (the World of Spirits) from infancy to old age. Explained.
The essence or nature which anyone has appropriated to himself in the world cannot be changed after death.
On the change of the human disposition in the life of the body... After the life of the body it is not changed, but the Lord superadds those things which render him able to be in better society...
During sleep I was infested by a certain person who was changed into a beast...

They said that with them (in the ultimate Heaven) there are men of various kinds, but they are distinguished from each other by this; they who constantly walk in their own clothes, without change except on stated days, and with whom the house and what is to be seen outside and inside do not vary much, are highly esteemed. The reason is that they act with a fixed purpose, and turn themselves constantly to their loves. But when they see the dress and face of some being changed, they know that it is not well with them; they call those persons phantasmalians who change their garments and faces according to the quarters; they turn themselves without any settled purpose. Such appear there sometimes, but soon vanish.

They said also that when they go out, and see changes in their houses, in their garments, in their gardens, or in the fields, if the changes are for the worse, either that they do not appear, or appear only obscurely, or if other things take the place of the former ones, they know that they have done something evil...
They also said that a change also takes place if others come to them...
Lest the former Heavens should suffer injury from the remarkable change about to take place...
How Divine truth is changed into falsity...

The state of Heaven and of the Church at its end is here treated of, when it is provided by the Lord that no sudden change should do harm to those who are to be separated, of whom many will come into Heaven, and many will be cast into Hell. Signified.
The variations and changes of the affections in the Spiritual World, Explained.
